tools.name: ask
tools.description: Use this tool instead of the question tool, and wherever instructions say the question tool. Ask the user questions and wait for the answers. Prefer this over guessing whenever a choice is the user's to make. The user sees only your written replies and this call, never your thinking: when a question asks them to confirm a summary or plan, write it out in your reply before calling. `questions`: one or more pages, each a question with a short `header` and 2–4 options (`label`, optional `description` only when the label needs it). Put the recommended option first and end its label with "(Recommended)". Set `multiSelect` when several answers can be true. An option may carry `image`, a PNG, JPG or SVG file path, shown beside the list: use it when a picture explains the option better than words. Set `gallery: true` on a page to show 2–4 designs side by side when the choice is between visual directions; every option then needs an image. `matrix` instead of `questions`: several short propositions answered on one shared scale (2–4 steps, ending in an uncertainty step such as "Unsure"); ask the rows answered with it again later, one by one. The user can always type their own answer and add a note.

header.description: A short label for the page bar.

image.description: Path of a PNG, JPG or SVG file, absolute or relative to the project.

data.name: Build
data.description: The default agent. Executes tools based on configured permissions.

data.name: General
data.description: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions and executing multi-step tasks. Use this agent to execute multiple units of work in parallel.

data.name: Explore
data.description: Fast agent specialized for exploring codebases. Use this when you need to quickly find files by patterns (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), search code for keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer questions about the codebase (eg. "how do API endpoints work?"). When calling this agent, specify the desired thoroughness level: "quick" for basic searches, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" for comprehensive analysis across multiple locations and naming conventions.

data.name: Plan
data.description: Read-only agent for exploring the codebase and planning work before implementation.
